tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures will not be acceptable.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory.

It will be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of KPP Portal on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The department will not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPP Portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode will be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The tender processing fee will not be refundable.
The employer reserves the rights to reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.
List of Employees details shall be enclosed, Employees should be of age 18 years and above.
Evaluation of Technical bid for qualification will be done based on the information provided the bidder as per his documents, duly verified if necessitates.
The Selection Process is Based on Quality Cost Based Selection. (QCBS)
Bidders/Tenderers should follow up and abide by the circular and memo issued by head office periodically.

The successful Tenderer should deliver to the employer a Security Deposit in the form of FDR/e-Bank guarantee (Any Nationalized bank / Scheduled Bank) as per government circular No:FD5/expenditure-12/2023 Dt:15.05.2023 / Insurance Surety Bonds issued by Insurance Company authorized by Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India as per government circular No:FD944/expenditure-12/2024 Dt:03.04.2025 in favour of the Administrator, CADA, CBP, Mysore for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price and plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in the form of DD/FDR/BG in favour of the Administrator, CADA, CBP, Mysore within 20 days in receipt of Letter of Acceptance in accordance with the conditions of contract at the time of agreement.
The tenderer should furnish the Formats filled and signed by the competent authority as mentioned in the Bid document
The tenderers are requested to abide by the instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender Documents KC-3 and further orders thereon.
As per GO LD/300/L.E.T/2006 Dt: 18.01.07, 1% of bill amount will be held towards labor Welfare Cess.

The successful bidder should execute work agreement within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of Acceptance, failing which his tender Will be cancelled on Risk & Cost basis & his EMD will be forfeited.

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity.
All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/private properties.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labor act.
Contractor should adhere to HSE (Health Safety Environment) policy applicable for similar projects.
Contractor to that extent should submit HSE document defining all the procedure including the policies before execution of the project.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP
Corrigendum will be published in the web site for all modifications/corrections, if any.
Security Deposit Will be withheld till the work completion certificate issued
Rates quoted should be Inclusive of GST. GST will be deducted as per the prevailing Govt Orders from time to time.
The Successful bidder should abide by the Rules and Regulations of the Tender and in any case if he is seen violating such Rules and Regulations, Agreement with such a bidder would be terminated.
Corrigendum will be published in the KPP Portal website only for any Further/modifications and corrections.
Further information about electronic tendering can be had from https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in/

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Average Annual Turnover of the firm/agency shall not be less than the Estimated Annual payment under this contract i.e., Rs. 3.00 Lakhs in any one FY out of last five financial years 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 obtained from Charted Accountant. Proof of Turnover / Certificate from Chartered Accountant bearing valid UDIN to be produced.
The approach and methodology shall clearly define the Consultants approach to complete the assignment within the time frame and methodology adopted.

The Consultant / Company / Ministry of Micro, Small and medium Enterprises. herein after referred to as the consultant should be registered with the Registrar of Companies and should have a minimum of 3 years of Experience as a Consultant/Company conducting similar assignments and should have a valid ISO certification.

The Consultant / Company/ Ministry of Micro, Small and medium Enterprises should have deploy the key personnel / man power for the assignment. Bio data of individual key personnel signed by the individual member shall be furnished 1- Team Leader, 1- Architect, 1- Structural Engineer, 1- Quantity Surveyor, 1- Electrical Engineer.

The Consultant Shall have successfully completed at least one similar assignment i.e., the firm should have executed Providing Consultancy Services for government organizations such as irrigation works/ building works/ roads and bridges with all necessary design and drawings for atleast One project in last 5 years i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26 for value not less than Rs 1.50 Lakhs. The CC should have been issued by not below the rank of EE of State/Central Government.

The Consultant/Company/ Ministry of Micro, Small and medium Enterprises. should have the following licensed software for carrying out the assignment. licensed software such as Auto CAD Civil 3D, E-survey and plotter Software etc. The certification/proof of ownership of the above equipments / software should be enclosed. The successful bidder is supposed to establish a Temporary office accessible easily to the workplace and to the client office.
